name: Manhasset Center
summary: Manhasset Center is a 180,948 square foot shopping center located on Northern Boulevard in the heart of an upscale North Shore Long Island neighborhood. Positioned just two miles from the renowned Americana luxury lifestyle center, it serves one of the region's most affluent communities with convenient retail and service options.
demographics: Manhasset Center serves an exceptionally affluent North Shore Long Island market with average household incomes of $312,513 within one mile and $233,723 within three miles. The trade area attracts upper-income families and professionals, with median household incomes of $181,100 nearby and per capita income exceeding $103,656. The shopping center draws approximately 33,192 daytime visitors within a mile radius, serving a sophisticated demographic that values convenience and quality in their daily shopping needs.
description: Manhasset Center is a premier shopping destination strategically located on Northern Boulevard in the heart of one of Long Island's most prestigious North Shore communities. Spanning 180,948 square feet of gross leasable area, this well-established center serves the affluent Manhasset neighborhood and surrounding areas with a carefully curated mix of retailers and services. Positioned just two miles west of the world-famous Americana luxury lifestyle center, Manhasset Center benefits from its proximity to high-end shopping while offering convenient, everyday retail options for local residents. The center is managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use assets. With its prime location in a market where average household incomes exceed $312,000 within one mile, Manhasset Center serves a discerning clientele seeking quality retailers and services in an accessible neighborhood setting.
